capabilities: Deliver a sermon from a full-screen view with hidden sidebars and a live timer
Tap Bible references to expand passages inline from vault files or an offline Bible
Jump between sections via an outline list and a right-edge section strip
Track section pacing from planned minutes written in headings
Round-trip to edit mode and recolor highlights from the preach view
extras: Screenshots are not yet available ('Coming after iPad testing'). Optional one-time 4.3 MB offline download of the public-domain Berean Standard Bible from bereanbible.com; otherwise no network use and no telemetry. Scripture expansion needs either Bible chapter files in the vault in one of two documented folder conventions or the offline download.
problem: Obsidian has no distraction-free, touch-friendly presentation mode for delivering a sermon or talk from a note, and Bible references in the text cannot be expanded and read aloud inline.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the Preach function in Logos Bible Software.
Reference-parsing approach ported from obsidian-bible-linker by Jakub Kuchejda (MIT).
Mobile-compatible plugin patterns informed by obsidian-bible-reference by tim-hub (MIT).

summary: Full-screen preach mode that turns a Markdown note into a sermon delivery view with timer, section pacing, outline navigation, and tap-to-expand scripture.
